title: When the Visitor Turns
author: Dominic Yarrow
blurb: Theo Joubert, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
